ruleDefinitions.name: File Download Via Bitsadmin To A Suspicious Target Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file to a suspicious target folder

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bitsadmin\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/transfer\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/addfile\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%ProgramData\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%public\\%.*")))
